tasks.subject: Task 1: URL words and paths
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `toUrlWord` and `buildEntryPaths` in a new `admin/lib/url-path.ts`, tested.

**Files:**
- Create: `admin/lib/url-path.ts`
- Create: `admin/lib/__tests__/url-path.test.ts`
- Modify: `admin/lib/README.md` (one line for the new file)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `toUrlWord` keeps U+05D0–U+05EA, U+05BE, U+05F3, U+05F4; turns each internal whitespace run into one `_`; drops everything else; input NFC-normalized first.
- [ ] `buildEntryPaths` numbers each word's entries 1..n in `compareByCodeUnit` id order, whatever order it is given.
- [ ] Number 1 is `/<word>`, others `/<word>-<n>`.
- [ ] Over the committed tree: 25,316 distinct words, 7,196 paths with a suffix, no empty word.

**Verify:** `bun test admin/lib/__tests__/url-path.test.ts` → all pass; `bun qa` exit 0.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Replace names with URL paths
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `admin/entry/names.ts` is gone; its three callers use `admin/lib/url-path.ts`; the only address check left is that no URL word is empty.

**Files:**
- Delete: `admin/entry/names.ts`, `admin/entry/__tests__/names.test.ts`
- Modify: `admin/entry/validate.ts:39,366` (`checkNames`)
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/import/gates.ts:8,560-605` (gate 7)
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/import/gates.test.ts`, `admin/entry/__tests__/validate.test.ts`
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/report/headword-issues.ts:25,395,413,776,989,1039` and its test
- Modify: `admin/lib/hebrew.ts:104` (comment naming `deriveFormName`)
- Regenerate: `docs/reports/headword-issues.md`, `docs/reports/headword-issues.csv`, `docs/reports/import-blessing.md` (by the import)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `findEmptyUrlWords(entries: readonly Pick<Entry, 'headwords' | 'id'>[]): string[]` in `admin/lib/url-path.ts` returns, in the order given, the rids whose `toUrlWord(headwords[0].text)` is empty (an entry with no forms counts as empty).
- [ ] `validate.ts` reports `<rid>: URL word is empty from <json text>` for each; its function is renamed `checkUrlWords`.
- [ ] Gate 7 is renamed `checkAddresses`, gate key `addresses`: one mark per entry for a non-empty URL word, one for `sefariaHeadword` equal to the source byte for byte (unchanged). Docstring rewritten for ruling `11-13 url words`.
- [ ] Two entries with the same URL word pass both checks (a test with two `אמר` entries).
- [ ] The headword-issues report's `name` column is renamed `url` and holds `buildEntryPaths(entries).get(rid)`, computed once per report.
- [ ] Over the committed tree A00055 is `/אבוב` and A00056 `/אבוב-2` (checked by a one-off script, not a test).
- [ ] Re-import: every gate green, `addresses=65024/65024`; the only changed files are the three reports.

**Verify:** `bun qa` exit 0; `bun data:validate` → `32512 entry file(s), 0 problem(s)`; re-import as in Global Constraints → `git status --short` lists only `docs/reports/headword-issues.{md,csv}`, `docs/reports/import-blessing.md` and the code.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Remove the disambiguator and formerNames
tasks.description:
**Goal:** No entry, schema, parser, gate, report or appendix rule holds or reads a superscript disambiguator; `formerNames` is gone; entries are rewritten at `schemaVersion` 3; P000307 and P000927 are deleted and P000955 loses its `²`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `admin/entry/schema.ts` (drop `disambiguator`, `formerNames`; `SCHEMA_VERSION = 3`; update the `display` description that names 10-06)
- Modify: `admin/entry/headwords.ts` (superscript marks are dropped by the parser; remove `readSuperscript`, `intToSup`, `supToInt`; `duplicateForms` keys on text and homograph only; keep `SUP_DIGITS` only if the parser still needs it to recognise the mark)
- Modify: `admin/entry/validate.ts:256-292` (`plainFields`: no `formerNames`; the comment's field list)
- Modify: `admin/entry/headword-rules.ts` (comments only: rule 3 stays; reword "a disambiguator's glyph" to "Sefaria's superscript")
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/import/gates.ts:7,130-175,255` (`notationOf` skips superscript digits, as it skips commas; `writtenNotation` drops the forms' superscripts)
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/report/headword-issues.ts:437,477,501,676,902` (`NumberedForm.sefariaSuperscript: string`, the first run of superscript digits (U+00B9, U+00B2, U+00B3, U+2070–U+2079) in `entry.sefariaHeadword` for index 0, `''` for alternates or when there is none; `numbersOnce` and `describeNumbered` use it)
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/report/sefaria-change.ts` (remove `DISAMBIGUATOR_TAIL` and `bareForm`; the reorder rule compares NFC forms) and its test case (`['אבוב', 'איבוב']`, no `²`)
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/report/sefaria-evidence.ts:52` (remove the `headword-name-collision` row)
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/patch/records/reviewed/patches.jsonl` (delete P000307, P000927; P000955 `forms[0]` `אַבּוּב ²` → `אַבּוּב` and its rationale's disambiguator sentence removed), `manifest.jsonl` (delete the G00675 and C00300 rows)
- Modify: tests that name the field: `headwords.test.ts`, `headword-rules.test.ts`, `validate.test.ts`, `gates.test.ts`, `headword-issues.test.ts`, `schema.test.ts`, `reviewed-kept.test.ts`, `cite-numeral.test.ts`, and any literal `schemaVersion: 2`
- Regenerate: `data/schema/entry.schema.json` (`bun schema:build`), `data/entries/` (re-import), `docs/reports/*` (import, `bun data:sefaria`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `grep -rnE "disambiguator|formerNames|intToSup|supToInt|readSuperscript" admin data/schema` finds only comments that explain the removal, and `data/entries` holds no `"disambiguator"`.
- [ ] A parser test: `שׁוֹט ²` parses to one form `{ text: 'שׁוֹט' }` with no other field, and `display` without the superscript.
- [ ] A gate-2 test: a source line with `²` and an entry without it conserves notation.
- [ ] A `numbersOnce` test: two equal numerals whose entries' `sefariaHeadword` differ by `²` read as one sequence; without it, not.
- [ ] Re-import: every gate green; `headword-duplicate-form=4`.
- [ ] Entry diff is exactly the change: for every committed entry, the old JSON with `schemaVersion` set to 3 and every `disambiguator` removed equals the new JSON (a one-off script over `git show HEAD:<file>` against the working file; 32,512 equal).
- [ ] `docs/reports/headword-issues.{md,csv}`: no finding row added or removed against Task 2's output. Any changed row is listed in the commit body with its reason.
- [ ] `bun data:sefaria`: A00055's row reads `["אַבּוּב","אִיבּוּב"]`; no other appendix row changes.

**Verify:** `bun qa` exit 0; `bun schema:check` clean; `bun data:validate` → 0 problems; re-import gates green; the entry-diff script prints `32512 equal`.
